source_binding: Exact pilot corpus_id, repository, PR, baseline commit/tree, target commit/tree, diff SHA-256 and bytes are frozen in the authenticated execution manifest before review.
packet_requirement: Supervisor prepares a collision-resistant isolated packet containing only immutable binding, baseline/target source bytes, exact diff, prompt, policies, and schema. Packet manifest and root hashes freeze every byte; packet is read-only during child use.
cache_requirement: Collision-resistant local bare Git cache has exact canonical GitHub remote and all locked objects before packet creation.
missing_object_disposition: Fail closed as source-preparation no_go; never fetch during child review.
evidence_requirement: Every changed-symbol census location overlaps a changed hunk; every claim chain is dense, connected, snapshot-bound, and starts in a changed hunk.
execution_boundary: Supervisor prepares packets with argv-only bounded Git object reads. Children receive no command tool. Source is never imported, executed, installed, built, or tested.
